answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identity with unparallelizable time: before an agent may claim rewards, it must finish a sequential puzzle whose steps cannot be split across clones, so ten copies cost ten times the waiting, not one. Like a whisper carried across a quiet jetty only when spoken slowly, or a lotus opening on its own schedule, the delay cannot be faked by copying a key - each identity must pay its own hours before the network releases any reward.
